Drunk.note: The in-play player whose good character the Philosopher took; removed if the Philosopher dies.

Is The Philosopher.note: The Philosopher's own seat after their token is swapped for the chosen character.

setupPrep.none: its tokens mark what a player chooses at night, placed when they choose

reminderMovement.why: The choice is made once; its drunk player and the Philosopher stay marked.

reminderPlaceholders.note: An in-play character's player is drunk; otherwise the Philosopher becomes it.

full.text: The Philosopher might choose a good character: record it as their gained ability. If that character is in play, its player is drunk: mark them *DRUNK*.
full.reason: The app records the chosen ability on the Philosopher, who keeps their token (Trevor, 2026-11-03).
